java_baseline.note: Same release and asset hash as the golden baseline in docs/golden.md. Bump deliberately with real_world_parity.py jar --adopt-latest, never automatically.

thresholds.note: Wall time and RSS are advisory by default: shared CI runners are too noisy to gate on. Pass --strict-perf to turn a breach into a failure.

gate.note: java_parity only applies to feeds where the Java baseline actually ran, so a guru-only run scores out of a smaller total.
